title: Dashboard tiles load quickly and one slow tile does not hold up the others
pre_body:
Preconditions

  1. User: you are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. Location: you are in the busiest location (workplace) you can reach: the one with the most invoices and clocked time, so every tile has real work to do.
  3. Before you start: you have a stopwatch or a phone timer ready.
